design_brief_zh: 主卖点是Sliver外观下的三种尺寸选择，重点展示20寸61×42×27 cm、4 kg、42 L，同时用24寸和26寸规格形成可验证对比。层级严格按：标题→选择说明→20寸规格→24寸规格→26寸规格；五行文案分别对应五个copy_slots。PC 2000×2000与移动端1200×1200均采用上方场景/产品、底部文案的阅读顺序：产品区域[x,y,w,h]=[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，文案区域[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.64,0.9,0.31]。上方并排放置同一Sliver外观的20/24/26寸旅行箱，以正面或轻微三分之四角度展示比例、竖条纹箱面、铝合金框和轮组；用清晰尺寸线分别标出箱体高度与宽度，三位不同身高的商务成人、女性成人和儿童可站在旁边作比例参照，但不得暗示儿童承重。底部按从左到右或从上到下对应三种尺寸规格，数字优先、单位清晰，德语预留约20%文字扩展空间。采用欧洲现代旅行摄影、低饱和中性色背景与自然侧光，保持真实材质和比例，不展示未被证据支持的其他颜色。字体使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题较大加粗，说明文字中等，规格数字最大且高对比；避免价格、促销角标和额外功能干扰规格选择。
compliance_note_zh: 仅展示已提供的Sliver颜色及20/24/26寸尺寸、尺寸数据、重量和容量；重量与容量单位按产品规格展示为kg和L。不得把Sliver改写成未经确认的其他颜色，不得虚构防水、登机适配、承重、认证或耐用测试；所有尺寸线和数字必须与实际产品比例一致。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium European modern travel photography infographic for a YWJ hard-shell suitcase size comparison, square 2000×2000 PC composition adaptable to 1200×1200 mobile. Upper 53%: show three identical Sliver-finish suitcases in 20-inch, 24-inch, and 26-inch sizes, arranged side by side with clear physical scale differences, front or slight three-quarter views, visible vertical shell texture, aluminum frame, corner guards, handle and wheels. Place a business traveler, an adult woman, and a child beside the respective suitcases only as height references; do not show the child carrying one. Add clean measurement guide lines aligned to each suitcase, but do not render any text, numbers, labels, logos, or symbols in the image. Lower 31% is a clean reserved copy panel with generous empty space for five lines of localized copy; maintain the same upper-scene/lower-copy reading order on mobile. Use low-saturation neutral surroundings, natural soft side lighting, realistic proportions, restrained navy and warm orange accents, crisp product edges, and a high-end trustworthy Amazon lifestyle aesthetic. No rendered text anywhere.
